player_prompt.intro:
U wena Player {player_id} ka Chopsticks. Ha wena sebaka, khethe e 'ngoe ya:
  + Tšosa:  '[attack M O]'  moo M=e wena letsoho (0 kapa 1), O=letsoho la mokhahlele (0 kapa 1).
    - Palo ya letsoho la mokhahlele e eketseha ka letsoho la hao; ha e fihla >=5, e fetoha 0.
  + Arola:   '[split L R]'  ho arola menwana ya hao yohle ho L le R (L+R = yohle ya hao).
Araba ka e 'ngoe feela ya ditaelo tseo.

invalid_move.opp_hand_dead: Letsoho la mohanyetsi {opp_idx} le se le shoele.
invalid_move.split_sum: Ho aroloa ho tlameha hore e be {total}.
invalid_move.split_no_change: Ho arohana ho tlameha hore ebe ho fetola tsela eo u abelang matsoho ka eona.
invalid_move.invalid_command: Tšeo di sa hlakahlisitswe. Sebelisa “[attack M O]” kapa “[split L R]”.

game_action.attack: P{player_id} e tšosa letsoho la P{opp_id} {opp_idx}: le fihla ho tloha {opp_val} go ya {new_val}.

outcome.draw: Moeli oa ho fetoha o fihlile.
